warning.titlePre: Mercedes AMG GT C Oil Leaks & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: AMG GT C engines with the M178 4.0-litre V8 — that's the C190 generation, built from 2015 to 2023 — commonly show oil leaks from the valve covers and coolant system wear. This is a well-established pattern on M178 engines, confirmed by AMG specialist consensus across the UK. We replace valve covers, gaskets and coolant system components as standard on every M178 rebuild.
